statement: MixedStepNeg (mixed slack |F2Mix|-baseDQ has a 1- or 0-step with no larger slack at every negative state of a MinCE) is stated as a Prop; MixedStepNeg implies no_minCE, proved.

The mixed step at negative states is the count: for one gate list, a non-increasing 0- or 1-step at every negative mixed state iff mslack >= 0 at every mixed state; so MixedStepNeg iff every MinCE has mslack >= 0 at all mixed states; and the abstract descent hypothesis of no_minCE_of_mixed_descent iff 0 <= slack(empty).

S3(a) per-set flip lemma, any number of NOT gates: for a correct SearchCheck.Circ, a set S with output o and a zero point Z of S, |S| <= (flip classes with |D|>=2 at (S,Z), wire functions up to complement) + 1; abstract graph argument Core.core.

System of ORs, any number of NOT gates: gates >= n - comp (components of the union graph, isolated inputs count), via B2's partition argument. Equals base = sum(|S_i|-1) for pairwise disjoint nonempty sets and for the chain {i,i+1}. In general n-comp <= base, equality iff the incidence graph is a forest (math, not formalised); for overlapping sets in a cycle or with two shared points the bound is strictly below base and says nothing more.

One NOT gate: a wire can drop 1->0 along x<=z only if the NOT input h rises 0->1 (sign_of_drop); unit merge candidates of two sets at a mixed state force both sets DD (h=1 at the top zero point, h=0 at a unit atom) (overlap_needs_DD); a non-DD set's unit merge candidates are F2Mix witnesses (F2WitMix_of_unit_noDD) and its unit test system is GoodT (goodT_of_noDD, unit_count_of_noDD)
